Construct Stan data for spawnBayes

Source: R/make_stan_data.R
make_stan_data.Rd

Convert validated survey data and prior specifications into the data list required by the spawnBayes Stan model.

Usage

make_stan_data(data, priors, outlier_model = TRUE)

Arguments

data

A validated data frame containing survey observations.

priors

A prior specification object returned by default_priors().

outlier_model

Logical. If TRUE, include the outlier observation model in the Stan data passed to spawnBayes.

Value

A list containing:

stan_data

Data list supplied to Stan.

day_stand

Reference day used for day standardization.

year_lookup

Mapping between Stan year indices and calendar years.
